title: Glowing armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb347' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='46' ry='36' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- backrest -->
  <rect x='22' y='20' width='56' height='40' rx='14' fill='#e0603a'/>
  <rect x='22' y='20' width='56' height='18' rx='9' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <rect x='29' y='26' width='42' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd9b0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='52' height='22' rx='10' fill='#f2724a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='56' width='40' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffb18a'/>

  <!-- left armrest -->
  <rect x='12' y='44' width='16' height='32' rx='8' fill='#c94a26'/>
  <rect x='12' y='44' width='16' height='10' rx='5' fill='#ff9a6e'/>
  <rect x='14' y='47' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe0c4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <rect x='72' y='44' width='16' height='32' rx='8' fill='#c94a26'/>

  <rect x='74' y='47' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe0c4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- front skirt -->
  <rect x='26' y='72' width='48' height='8' rx='4' fill='#b83d1c'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='20' y='78' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8a2c12'/>
  <rect x='72' y='78' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8a2c12'/>
  <rect x='20' y='78' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d6542c'/>
  <rect x='72' y='78' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d6542c'/>

  <!-- little sparkles of glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='3' fill='#fff2c4'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='60' r='2' fill='#fff2c4'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='62' r='2' fill='#fff2c4'/>
